description: MAX1044 charge pump (7660 family with a boost pin, 10.5 V maximum supply): the Klon Centaur's

source.licence: values read from the manufacturer's data sheet

note: A behavioural model, not the chip's circuit: the figures read from the maker's sheet (pump frequency, output resistance, supply current) drive Solum Builder's own model of a charge pump, switching ripple included (D-093).

rating_sources.vs_max: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19): Absolute Maximum Ratings, Supply Voltage (V+ to GND, or GND to VOUT) 10.5 V

package.name: 8-pin DIP
package.source: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19), Pin Configuration and Pin Description: BOOST 1 (MAX1044), CAP+ 2, GND 3, CAP- 4, VOUT 5, LV 6, OSC 7, V+ 8. The pump's caps and diodes are drawn parts (D-226).

param_sources.f_pump: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19), page 9: "the pump frequency is around 4kHz or 5kHz" with no OSC cap (the pump runs at half the oscillator, page 8)
param_sources.f_pump_boost: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19), page 4, Oscillator Frequency vs. Temperature, curve A (MAX1044 with BOOST = V+, V+ = 5 V): about 55 kHz at 25 C, read off the figure; halved for the pump (page 8: "The pump and output ripple frequencies are one-half the" clock frequency)
param_sources.r_out: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19): Output Resistance 65 ohms typ at I_L = 20 mA, f_OSC = 5 kHz, V+ = 5 V, 25 C (Electrical Characteristics, MAX1044 column)
param_sources.i_q: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19): Supply Current 30 uA typ, R_L = infinity, pins 1 and 7 no connection, 25 C (Electrical Characteristics, MAX1044 column)
param_sources.i_q_boost: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19), page 4, Quiescent Current vs. Oscillator Frequency (using an external capacitor): about 300 uA near 55 kHz, read off the figure; the table gives no figure with BOOST on V+
param_sources.c_pump: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19): C1 = C2 = 10 uF, the Typical Operating Characteristics' conditions and page 8's "10uF charge-pump capacitors"

datasheet.source: Maxim MAX1044/ICL7660 data sheet, 19-4667 Rev 3 (6/19), page 8: "with a 5V input voltage and 10uF charge-pump capacitors ... the output voltage is about -5V under light loads, and decreases to about -4.5V with a 10mA load current"
datasheet.note: That paragraph says the output resistance is typically 50 ohms; the model uses the table's 65 ohms typ, so it reads 0.15 V lower.
